Problem: Write a python function to calculate the number of odd days in a given year.
Signature: odd_Days(int) -> int

reply:
```t
t 1
gate loops
task mbpp_509__average_Odd(n: int) returns (r: int)
  requires n >= 1
  requires n % 2 == 1
  ensures 2 * r == n + 1
{
  r := (n + 1) / 2;
}
```
